paragraphs: At the beginning of each month, compile monitoring data on water levels and withdrawals and validate models with hydrologists. Mid-quarter, calculate supply-demand balances and negotiate quotas with environmental and agricultural agencies. Before planning deadlines, inspect limits and efficiency and revise proposals several times. Routinely handle approvals and inspections and monitor water quality and quantity. At year-end, complete an inventory and clearly document the next year's allocation strategy.
